transform.name: increase_occupancy
transform.description: 提高占用率（occupancy）：增大 grid 规模、合理 block_size，让更多 warp 常驻 SM 以隐藏访存延迟；适用于并行度不足、latency 受限的 naive 内核。
transform.code_hint:
// dim3 block(16,16) or (32,8); dim3 grid((N+block.x-1)/block.x, (N+block.y-1)/block.y);
// more resident warps hide global-memory latency; avoid serial dependency/branches

failure_modes: block_size 过大导致每 SM 可常驻 block 数减少，占用率反而下降
寄存器/共享内存占用过高限制占用率

evidence.source: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.10 Execution Configuration Optimizations

provenance: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.10 Execution Configuration Optimizations
